1 /**
2  * THE CONVERSATIONAL STEWARD (2026-08-04).
3  *
4  * WHY THIS MODULE EXISTS. The chamber compiled talk through ELEVEN closed acts matched by
5  * regex (`dialogue.mjs` ACT_TABLE). Free-form speech matched none of them, so describing a
6  * project — the one thing North Star SC1 says must produce a scaffolding — dead-ended on
7  * "Ecgberht could not compile that to a closed act". The scaffolding path added later
8  * (`deriveStagesFromDictation`) kept ones opening with a verb from a CLOSED LIST, which
9  * returns 0 stages on John's real writing (his verbs are revise/keep/integrate/replace/
10  * open/add/refresh). Widening the list just moves the failure to the next project.
11  *
12  * THE DESIGN ERROR IT FIXES. Two invariants drove the original build and BOTH ARE GOOD:
13  *   E5 — chat is NEVER persisted (Strip receipts + roadmap events + Face are the sole ledger)
14  *   the steward never invents — unknown is spoken as unknown; nothing written unconfirmed
15  * The implementation conflated "don't persist chat" with "don't use a model to understand
16  * what he said". Those are ORTHOGONAL. A model can hold the conversation and propose
17  * structure while only confirmed receipts persist. This module is that separation.
18  *
19  * HOW THE CONVERSATION HOLDS TOGETHER ACROSS TURNS — without a chat ledger. The bridge is
20  * spawned fresh per request and dies, so turn 2 would know nothing of turn 1. Three sources
21  * rebuild the context each turn, and NONE of them is a persisted transcript:
22  *   1. the open `scaffold_proposal` event on the spine — the scaffolding-so-far. It is
23  *      already an admitted spine kind, so a re-proposal is normal history, not a restart.
24  *   2. the ephemeral turns the CALLER holds in memory (browser page / test) and replays.
25  *      They die with the session and are asserted never to reach an event.
26  *   3. Face + roadmap projection + Strip — the campaign itself.
27  *
28  * WHAT STAYS DETERMINISTIC. The control verbs — carry on / park that / confirm commission /
29  * switch seat — still compile through the closed act table. A model must NEVER decide to
30  * spend or to write. Everything else John says goes to the seat.
31  *
32  * ENGINE LAW: nothing under engine/ may import child_process or call spawn*(). The seat
33  * call arrives as an INJECTED `seatCall` hook; the real transport lives in
34  * scripts/seat-call.mjs, outside engine/.
35  *
36  * Stdlib only. No host-absolute user homes in shipped strings.
37  */
38

179 // ── Routing: control verbs stay deterministic ──────────────────────────────

181 /**
182  * Longest utterance (in words) that may compile to a CONTROL act.
183  *
184  * WHY A LENGTH GUARD. Not every act pattern is ^-anchored — `park (that|this|the)
185  * (idea|thought)` and `show (me )?(the )?detail` match ANYWHERE in the text. John dictates
186  * whole paragraphs, so a 300-word project description containing "...and show me the
187  * detail on that later..." would compile to a control act and never reach the steward at
188  * all. A control verb is a SHORT deliberate instruction; a paragraph is talk.
189  */
190 export const ACT_MAX_WORDS = 8;
191 
192 /**
193  * @param {string} text
194  * @returns {number}
195  */
196 function wordCount(text) {
197   const s = String(text ?? '').trim();
198   return s ? s.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
199 }
200 
201 /**
202  * Decide where an utterance goes: the closed act table, or the seat.
203  *
204  * Deterministic and zero-model — the routing law itself is never a model decision, and it
205  * lives HERE (engine) rather than in the browser so the bridge and the UI cannot drift
206  * apart about what counts as a control verb.
207  *
208  * @param {string} text
209  * @param {{ session?: object }} [ctx]
210  * @returns {{ lane: 'act'|'converse'|'refuse', compiled?: object, reason?: string }}
211  */
212 export function routeUtterance(text, ctx = {}) {
213   const trimmed = String(text ?? '').trim();
214   if (!trimmed) return { lane: 'refuse', reason: 'empty_utterance' };
215 
216   if (wordCount(trimmed) <= ACT_MAX_WORDS) {
217     // A SHORT utterance is command-shaped, so the destructive guard belongs here:
218     // "delete all projects" must never compile to a verb.
219     if (matchesDestructive(trimmed)) {
220       return { lane: 'refuse', reason: 'destructive_free_form' };
221     }
222     const compiled = compileUtterance(trimmed, ctx);
223     if (compiled.compiled) return { lane: 'act', compiled };
224   } else {
225     // A Campaign verb (High Seat W5) is command-shaped from its first word — "add a part to MBA Teaching: retool
226     // homework 2 due Oct 27" runs past eight words — so it compiles at any length; compileUtterance runs the
227     // destructive guard first, and the act writes nothing here: Anchor's Campaign writer applies it.
228     const compiled = compileUtterance(trimmed, ctx);
229     if (compiled.compiled && CAMPAIGN_ACT_IDS.includes(compiled.act)) return { lane: 'act', compiled };
230   }
231 
232   // WHY THE DESTRUCTIVE GUARD DOES NOT RUN ON THE CONVERSE LANE (found in the
233   // 2026-08-04 multi-turn smoke). John's real refinement was "...and DROP the separate
234   // 'lock the decisions' stage, fold those decisions into the syllabus stage" —
235   // DESTRUCTIVE_PATTERNS contains /\bdrop\b/, so the steward answered "Ecgberht will
236   // not compile destructive free-form talk" to an ordinary editorial instruction. He
237   // will say drop / remove / get rid of constantly while shaping a scaffolding.
238   //
239   // The guard's threat model is "free-form talk must never compile to a DESTRUCTIVE
240   // VERB". On this lane nothing executes: the seat runs read-only (SEAT_ALLOWED_TOOLS),
241   // the model has no write authority, and every proposal still needs a human
242   // hash-bound confirm. So there is nothing here for the guard to protect, and applying
243   // it anyway breaks the conversation it was meant to make safe.
244   return { lane: 'converse' };
245 }

249 /**
250  * Load the durable context for a turn. All three sources are the EXISTING ledger —
251  * this function opens no new store and creates no second memory.
252  *
253  * @param {string} projectPath
254  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, face?: object, roadmap?: object, strip?: object, open_proposal?: object|null }}
255  */
256 export function loadStewardContext(projectPath) {
257   const surfaces = loadProjectSurfaces(projectPath);
258   const loaded = loadProjectRoadmap(projectPath);
259   const roadmap = loaded.exists && loaded.ok ? loaded.roadmap : null;
260   const kickoff = roadmap ? projectKickoff(roadmap) : {
261     ok: true,
262     confirmed: null,
263     open: null,
264   };
265   if (!kickoff.ok) {
266     return {
267       ok: false,
268       code: CONVERSE_CODE.KICKOFF_CORRUPT,
269       kickoff_check: kickoff,
270     };
271   }
272 
273   // Gate 5 / Wave 3: the store (<folder>/.ecgberht/kickoff/events.jsonl) is the lineage
274   // of record for the kickoff conversation. A fresh session paints its latest OPEN
275   // version from the store alone; the roadmap-ledger projection is the pre-Gate-5 lane
276   // beside it. A store that cannot be read is reported by its own named row, never
277   // guessed around.
278   const store = readKickoffLineage(surfaces.project_path);
279   if (!store.ok) {
280     return { ok: false, code: store.code, store_check: store };
281   }
282 
283   // loadProjectSurfaces returns the PARSED Face document ({ok, narrative, raw,
284   // strip_fence}), so the narrative is read straight off it.
285   const narrative = surfaces.face?.narrative ?? null;
286 
287   const projection = Array.isArray(roadmap?.roadmap_projection)
288     ? roadmap.roadmap_projection : [];
289 
290   // THE STEP IN HAND, AND WHAT IT STILL NEEDS.
291   //
292   // This is what makes the steward walk alongside rather than hand over a document.
293   // John: "I don't want to have to scaffold it all and go do the detail stuff later —
294   // I could if I want to, but I don't have to." So detail is not demanded up front; it
295   // is asked for one step at a time, when that step becomes the work.
296   //
297   // All three calls are PURE reads — no probe is written just because he opened the
298   // chamber. The steward asks in its own voice, in the conversation; answers land as
299   // typed elaboration events only when he actually answers.
300   const active = findActiveStep(projection);
301   let stepGaps = [];
302   if (active && roadmap) {
303     const detail = reconstructStepDetail(roadmap, active.step_id ?? active.id);
304     if (detail && detail.ok !== false) {
305       const predicate = evaluateCommissionability(detail);
306       if (!predicate.ready) stepGaps = deriveTargetedQuestions(predicate, detail);
307     }
308   }
309 
310   // LIVE COMMISSIONED RUNS (2026-08-06, from John's day-one use). The seat could
311   // not see run state, so it DISAVOWED a genuinely running Gandalf ("your Go
312   // never reached the machinery") one turn after the machinery confirmed it.
313   // The host's run records are the truth; read them so "is it running?" gets a
314   // real answer. Read-only, best-effort, never authoritative for the roadmap.
315   const commission_runs = readCommissionRuns(surfaces.project_path);
316 
317   // The step findings ledger — what runs and reflection have FED each step
318   // (2026-08-07). Read for context; never authoritative for status.
319   const findings = readStepFindings(surfaces.project_path);
320   const step_findings = findings.ok ? findings.steps : {};
321 
322   // The DURABLE conversation — how the plan got where it is, in his words and the
323   // steward's. Read for RECALL only; project state above still comes from the Face,
324   // roadmap and Strip, and the ledger always wins (see conversation-log.mjs).
325   const history = readConversationLog(surfaces.project_path, { limit: 20 });
326 
327   return {
328     ok: true,
329     project_path: surfaces.project_path,
330     narrative,
331     strip: surfaces.strip ?? null,
332     roadmap,
333     projection,
334     active_step: active,
335     step_gaps: stepGaps,
336     confirmed_kickoff: store.confirmed ?? kickoff.confirmed,
337     open_kickoff: store.open ?? kickoff.open,
338     open_proposal: store.open ?? kickoff.open
339       ?? (roadmap ? findOpenScaffoldProposal(roadmap) : null),
340     kickoff_store: {
341       state: store.state,
342       next_version: store.next_version,
343       prior_confirmed_hash: store.prior_confirmed_hash,
344       proposal_count: store.proposal_count,
345       receipt_count: store.receipt_count,
346     },
347     commission_runs,
348     step_findings,
349     history: history.ok ? history.turns : [],
350     history_unreadable: history.ok ? false : true,
351   };
352 }

354 /**
355  * The host's commission run records (.anchor/commission-runs/*.json), newest
356  * first, as small honest projections. Missing dir → empty; unreadable file →
357  * skipped. Never a transcript, never a worktree path.
358  * @param {string} projectPath
359  */
360 export function readCommissionRuns(projectPath) {
361   const rows = [];
362   try {
363     const dir = path.join(path.resolve(projectPath), '.anchor', 'commission-runs');
364     if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return rows;
365     for (const name of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
366       if (!name.endsWith('.json')) continue;
367       try {
368         const rec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, name), 'utf8'));
369         rows.push({
370           skill: rec.skill ?? null,
371           step_id: rec.step_id ?? null,
372           outcome: rec.outcome ?? null,
373           at: rec.at ?? null,
374           elapsed_s: rec.elapsed_s ?? null,
375           session_id: rec.session_id ?? null,
376           needs: rec.report?.needs ?? null,
377           say: rec.report?.say ?? null,
378         });
379       } catch { /* skip unreadable record */ }
380     }
381     rows.sort((a, b) => String(b.at ?? '').localeCompare(String(a.at ?? '')));
382   } catch { /* dir unreadable → empty */ }
383   return rows;
384 }
385 
386 /**
387  * The step the conversation is currently ABOUT.
388  *
389  * A running step wins; otherwise the first step not yet done — which is what "we are
390  * here now" means on a campaign that has started but has nothing in flight. Null when
391  * there are no confirmed steps at all (the scaffolding conversation).
392  *
393  * @param {Array} projection
394  * @returns {object|null}
395  */
396 export function findActiveStep(projection) {
397   const steps = Array.isArray(projection) ? projection : [];
398   if (!steps.length) return null;
399   const running = steps.find((s) => s.status === 'running' || s.status === 'in_progress');
400   if (running) return running;
401   return steps.find((s) => s.status !== 'done' && s.status !== 'cancelled') ?? null;
402 }

500   'project description, he wants the coarse map FIRST and the questions after.',
501   'Do not interrogate him before showing a map he can react to. If the description',
502   'already supplies a goal, finished-state signals, and enough structure to frame',
503   'a useful first slice, set wants_plan true and leave asks empty. A ritual question',
504   'would make a complete opening feel like a form.',
505 ].join('\n');
506 
507 /**
508  * THE PLANNING INSTRUCTION — used only when a scaffolding is actually to be produced,
509  * by the FRONTIER tier. This is the turn worth waiting for.
510  */
511 export const STEWARD_PLAN_INSTRUCTION = [
512   `You are ${SPELLING}, John's project steward, framing a conversational kickoff synthesis.`,
513   '',
514   'You are one reply in the chamber conversation, not a terminal session. Never',
515   'mention permission modes, tools, or your harness, and never claim to have',
516   'written or launched anything. This is a proposal John can revise by talking;',
517   'the machinery applies it only after one explicit confirmation.',
518   '',
519   'KEEP THE CATEGORIES DISTINCT:',
520   '- goal: why the project exists;',
521   '- success_signals: observable evidence that the finished effort worked;',
522   '- work_product.components: stable parts of the thing being delivered;',
523   '- plan_entries: coarse work that creates or validates those parts;',
524   '- integration: how multiple parts become one finished whole and how that join is observed.',
525   'Execution phases such as research, build, integrate, or harden are metadata later;',
526   'they are never substitutes for work-product components.',
527   '',
528   'USE ONLY AS MUCH STRUCTURE AS THE EFFORT EARNS:',
529   '- A genuinely simple effort has one component and integration=null.',
530   '- Use multiple components only when parts are independently understandable and',
531   '  their interfaces or assembly matter. Then integration is REQUIRED: typed',
532   '  relationships must cover every component, plus an observable proof and method.',
533   '- Use more plan entries only when order, risk, learning, or independent validation',
534   '  makes them useful. Never pad to a target count.',
535   '- At least one plan entry is an end-to-end slice that touches enough of the real',
536   '  product to prove the whole direction. first_slice_id names the earliest one.',
537   '- Use stable lowercase IDs. Every plan entry names the component IDs it advances.',
538   '- Never invent a fact, date, constraint, or done condition. Never emit a tautology',
539   '  such as "Stage X meets its done-when."',
540   '- If the opening is already rich, asks must be empty. Show the synthesis first;',
541   '  do not add a ceremonial question.',
542   '',
543   'REPLY FORMAT — reply with ONLY a JSON object, no prose outside it, no code fence:',
544   '{',
545   '  "say": "<at most 100 words: the synthesis and the one thing worth reacting to>",',
546   '  "asks": [],',
547   '  "proposal": {',
548   '    "kind": "kickoff",',
549   '    "goal": "<one line>",',
550   '    "success_signals": ["<observable finished-state signal>"],',
551   '    "material_constraints": ["<only constraints John actually supplied>"],',
552   '    "work_product": {',
553   '      "id": "<stable-id>", "name": "<the one deliverable>",',
554   '      "components": [',
555   '        {"id": "<stable-id>", "name": "<component>",',
556   '         "done_when": "<optional concrete component condition>"}',
557   '      ]',
558   '    },',
559   '    "integration": null | {',
560   '      "summary": "<how the components become the whole>",',
561   '      "relationships": [',
562   '        {"kind": "feeds" | "depends_on" | "assembles_with" | "validates" | "integrates",',
563   '         "component_ids": ["<id>", "<id>"], "description": "<the real join>"}',
564   '      ],',
565   '      "proof": {"observable": "<what a person can observe>",',
566   '                "method": "<how to demonstrate it>"}',
567   '    },',
568   '    "plan_entries": [',
569   '      {"id": "<stable-id>", "name": "<coarse plan entry>",',
570   '       "component_ids": ["<component-id>"], "end_to_end_slice": true | false,',
571   '       "done_when": "<concrete condition>"}',
572   '    ],',
573   '    "first_slice_id": "<id of an end_to_end_slice entry>"',
574   '  }',
575   '}',
576 ].join('\n');
577 
578 /**
579  * Build the full prompt for one turn. PURE — deterministic given its inputs, so a test can
580  * assert the prompt without a model, and the recorded-reply gate can assert the prompt did
581  * not drift out from under its recording.
582  *
583  * @param {{ narrative?: object|null, projection?: Array, open_proposal?: object|null, strip?: object|null }} context
584  * @param {string} utterance
585  * @param {{ turns?: Array<{role: string, text: string}> }} [opts]
586  * @returns {string}
587  */
588 export function buildStewardPrompt(context = {}, utterance = '', opts = {}) {
589   const instruction = opts.planning ? STEWARD_PLAN_INSTRUCTION : STEWARD_TALK_INSTRUCTION;
590   const lines = [instruction];
591   lines.push('Discovery is adaptive: ask one consequential question at a time with context, why it matters, '
592     + 'a recommendation and what its answer authorizes. Carry earlier answers forward from durable history. '
593     + 'Usually three or four questions suffice; do not enforce a quota, a two-turn cutoff, or repeat known answers. '
594     + 'Clarify shared versus group-specific deliverables, independent acceptance and essential prerequisites when relevant. '
595     + 'Frame the plan when the intent is clear enough, retaining reversible assumptions and unresolved later choices.');
596   // Gate 5 / Wave 3: on a THIN turn (turn >= KICKOFF_THIN_PROPOSAL_BY_TURN of a sparse
597   // opening, nothing open or confirmed) the planning tier owes the smallest honest bundle.
598   // Deliberately CONDITIONAL, like every other block: no thin turn -> no block -> every
599   // recorded prompt stays byte-identical.
600   if (opts.planning && opts.thin_turn) lines.push('', thinBundleInstruction(opts.thin_turn));
601   lines.push('', '--- CAMPAIGN CONTEXT ---');
602 
603   const n = context.narrative ?? {};
604   lines.push(`North star: ${nonEmptyOr(n.north_star, '(not set)')}`);
605   lines.push(`Active effort: ${nonEmptyOr(n.active_effort, '(none)')}`);
606   if (nonEmptyOr(n.human_wait, '')) lines.push(`Waiting on John: ${n.human_wait}`);
607 
608   const projection = Array.isArray(context.projection) ? context.projection : [];
609   const stepFindings = context.step_findings ?? {};
610   if (projection.length) {
611     lines.push('', 'Confirmed roadmap steps (already written — do not re-propose these):');
612     for (const step of projection) {
613       const sid = step.step_id ?? step.id;
614       const facts = Array.isArray(stepFindings[sid]) ? stepFindings[sid] : [];
615       lines.push(`- [${step.status ?? 'unknown'}] ${step.name ?? step.step_id}`
616         + (facts.length ? ` · ${facts.length} finding${facts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} on file` : ''));
617     }
618     // WHAT THE CAMPAIGN HAS LEARNED (conditional — absent when nothing fed).
619     // The glue John asked for: run findings inform the NEXT move, so the seat
620     // sees them where it reasons, not stashed in a report nobody re-reads.
621     const learned = [];
622     for (const step of projection) {
623       const sid = step.step_id ?? step.id;
624       const facts = Array.isArray(stepFindings[sid]) ? stepFindings[sid] : [];
625       for (const f of facts.slice(-4)) {
626         learned.push(`- [${sid}] ${f.finding}${f.source ? ` (${f.source})` : ''}`);
627       }
628     }
629     if (learned.length) {
630       lines.push('', 'WHAT THE CAMPAIGN HAS LEARNED (from finished runs — use it to aim the next move):');
631       lines.push(...learned.slice(0, 16));
632     }
633   } else {
634     lines.push('', 'Confirmed roadmap steps: none yet.');
635   }
636 
637   const confirmedKickoff = context.confirmed_kickoff;
638   if (confirmedKickoff) {
639     lines.push(
640       '',
641       `CONFIRMED KICKOFF v${confirmedKickoff.version} (authoritative intent):`,
642       `Goal: ${confirmedKickoff.goal}`,
643       `Work product: ${confirmedKickoff.work_product.name}`,
644       `Components: ${confirmedKickoff.work_product.components.map((c) => `${c.id}=${c.name}`).join(' · ')}`,
645       'Do not replace this confirmed version merely because a newer preview is open.',
646     );
647   }
648 
649   // LIVE RUNS ride the prompt so "is it running?" is answered from RECORDS,
650   // never guessed. Deliberately CONDITIONAL: no runs → no block → prompts
651   // without runs stay byte-identical (the recorded acceptance tape holds).
652   const runs = Array.isArray(context.commission_runs) ? context.commission_runs : [];
653   if (runs.length) {
654     lines.push('', '--- COMMISSIONED RUNS (host records — the truth about what is running) ---');
655     for (const r of runs.slice(0, 5)) {
656       lines.push(
657         `- ${r.skill ?? 'skill'} for step '${r.step_id ?? '?'}': ${r.outcome}`
658         + (r.outcome === 'running' ? ` (launched ${r.at ?? '?'} — a live session is working now)` : '')
659         + (r.needs ? ` — waiting on John: ${r.needs}` : ''),
660       );
661     }
662     lines.push(
663       'Answer any "is it running / what is happening" question FROM THIS LIST.',
664       'A running entry means the machinery genuinely launched it — never deny or',
665       're-propose a run this list already shows. John can watch a running session',
666       'via its green Running strip in the chamber ("Open the session").',
667     );
668   }
669 
670   // ONCE THE CAMPAIGN IS RUNNING the conversation changes shape: it stops being about
671   // the whole scaffolding and becomes about the step in hand. This is the difference
672   // between a one-shot planner and a steward — John asked for detail to get filled in
673   // by talking, step by step, rather than demanded up front.
674   const active = context.active_step;
675   if (active) {
676     const gaps = Array.isArray(context.step_gaps) ? context.step_gaps : [];
677     lines.push(
678       '',
679       `THE STEP IN HAND: "${active.name}" (${active.status}).`,
680       active.done_when ? `Its done-when: ${active.done_when}` : '',
681       active.oranges_annotations?.length
682         ? `Foresight already recorded for it: ${active.oranges_annotations.join(' · ')}`
683         : '',
684       'Ask only for what THIS step needs to move — not for the whole campaign\'s detail.',
685       'If it is finished, say what you think was learned and propose the next stage',
686       '(set proposal.kind to "next_stage").',
687     );
688   }
689   const done = projection.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length;
690   if (projection.length && done === projection.length) {
691     lines.push('', 'Every confirmed step is done — the campaign needs its next stage.');
692   }
693 
694   // The scaffolding-so-far. This is what makes turn N+1 a REFINEMENT rather than a
695   // restart — without it he would have to re-describe the project every time.
696   const open = context.open_proposal;
697   if (open && open.kind === 'kickoff_proposal'
698       && Array.isArray(open.plan_entries) && open.plan_entries.length) {
699     lines.push(
700       '',
701       `KICKOFF SYNTHESIS v${open.version} (not confirmed — he is reacting to this):`,
702       `Goal: ${open.goal}`,
703       `Work product: ${open.work_product.name}`,
704       `Components: ${open.work_product.components.map((c) => `${c.id}=${c.name}`).join(' · ')}`,
705       `Plan entries: ${open.plan_entries.map((entry) => `${entry.id}=${entry.name}`).join(' · ')}`,
706       open.integration
707         ? `Integration: ${open.integration.summary} · proof: ${open.integration.proof.observable}`
708         : 'Integration: not needed; this is a one-component effort.',
709       'If he is refining it, return the WHOLE revised kickoff synthesis with the same stable IDs where meaning did not change.',
710     );
711   } else if (open && Array.isArray(open.steps) && open.steps.length) {
712     lines.push('', 'SCAFFOLDING YOU ALREADY PROPOSED (not yet confirmed — he is reacting to this):');
713     open.steps.forEach((s, i) => {
714       lines.push(`${i + 1}. ${s.name}${s.done_when ? ` — done when: ${s.done_when}` : ''}`);
715     });
716     lines.push(
717       'If he is refining it, return the WHOLE revised scaffolding, not just the changed part.',
718     );
719   }
720 
721   // THE DURABLE HISTORY — earlier sessions, so the steward can explain how the plan got
722   // here rather than only what it currently is. Read for recall; never for state.
723   const history = Array.isArray(context.history) ? context.history : [];
724   if (history.length) {
725     lines.push('', '--- EARLIER CONVERSATION ON THIS PROJECT (history, not state) ---');
726     for (const t of history) {
727       const who = t?.role === 'steward' ? SPELLING : 'John';
728       const text = String(t?.text ?? '').trim();
729       if (text) lines.push(`${who}${t.at ? ` [${String(t.at).slice(0, 10)}]` : ''}: ${text}`);
730     }
731     lines.push(
732       'That history is a RECORD OF WHAT WAS SAID, not the current plan. Where it '
733       + 'disagrees with the confirmed roadmap above, the roadmap is right.',
734     );
735   }
736   if (context.history_unreadable) {
737     lines.push('', 'NOTE: the earlier conversation history could not be read. Say so if it matters.');
738   }
739 
740   // Turns from the live session the caller is holding — replayed for immediacy. They
741   // land in the durable log once the turn succeeds.
742   const turns = Array.isArray(opts.turns) ? opts.turns : [];
743   if (turns.length) {
744     lines.push('', '--- THIS SESSION SO FAR ---');
745     for (const t of turns) {
746       const who = t?.role === 'steward' ? SPELLING : 'John';
747       const text = String(t?.text ?? '').trim();
748       if (text) lines.push(`${who}: ${text}`);
749     }
750   }
751 
752   // THE ANSWER LAW (steward-e1 W2, E1). Deliberately CONDITIONAL — like the
753   // COMMISSIONED RUNS block above: no enforceable bound (or no question this
754   // turn) → no block → every existing prompt stays byte-identical and the
755   // recorded acceptance tapes hold. The ids are DETERMINISTIC (computed by
756   // the Anchor sibling's committed bound, never here) — the seat answers the
757   // question; it never decides what counts as one.
758   const e1 = opts.e1;
759   const e1Questions = (e1 && e1.enforceable === true && Array.isArray(e1.questions))
760     ? e1.questions.filter((q) => q && q.question_id) : [];
761   if (e1Questions.length) {
762     lines.push(
763       '',
764       '--- ANSWER LAW (E1 — the ratified bound) ---',
765       `John's turn carries ${e1Questions.length} direct question(s), each with a machine id.`,
766       '',
767       'THIS SUPERSEDES THE REPLY FORMAT ABOVE FOR THIS TURN. The reply format',
768       'enumerates its keys and says "reply with ONLY a JSON object", so a reply',
769       'that honours it literally omits the key below and is then REFUSED — the',
770       'answer you wrote is discarded and John sees a block instead of it. The',
771       'object you return is the one described above WITH this key added:',
772       '',
773       '  "answer_references": [{"question_id": "<id, verbatim from the list below>",',
774       '                         "answer_text": "<your explicit answer to that question>"}]',
775       '',
776       'One entry per id below, covering EVERY id. The engine structurally',
777       'refuses to close a turn while any listed id lacks an answer-reference —',
778       'never walk away from one. Answer the question in "say" as you normally',
779       'would; answer_references is the machine-readable receipt, not a',
780       'substitute for talking to him.',
781     );
782     for (const q of e1Questions) {
783       lines.push(`- ${q.question_id}: "${String(q.text ?? '').trim()}"`);
784     }
785   }
786 
787   lines.push('', '--- JOHN JUST SAID ---', String(utterance ?? '').trim());
788   return lines.join('\n');
789 }
790 
791 function nonEmptyOr(v, fallback) {
792   const s = v == null ? '' : String(v).trim();
793   return s || fallback;
794 }
795 
796 /**
797  * Money for humans, with enough precision to be TRUE.
798  *
799  * The envelope's unit is synthetic and a compile can cost fractions of a cent, so a
800  * flat toFixed(2) renders a real budget as "$0.00 of $0.00" — a number that tells John
801  * nothing and reads like a bug. Small values get more places.
802  *
803  * @param {number} n
804  * @returns {string}
805  */
806 export function formatSpend(n) {
807   const v = Number(n) || 0;
808   if (v !== 0 && Math.abs(v) < 0.01) return `$${v.toFixed(6).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '')}`;
809   return `$${v.toFixed(2)}`;
810 }
811 
812 // ── Reply parsing (strict — a bad reply is refused, never guessed at) ──────
813 
814 /**
815  * Pull a JSON object out of a seat reply.
816  *
817  * The probe showed `claude -p` returns bare JSON, but a seat may fence it or add a
818  * sentence around it. We accept those, and REFUSE anything else — a reply we cannot read
819  * is reported honestly rather than salvaged into a plausible-looking plan.
820  *
821  * @param {string} raw
822  * @returns {object|null}
823  */
824 export function extractReplyJson(raw) {
825   const text = String(raw ?? '').trim();
826   if (!text) return null;
827 
828   const fenced = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/i);
829   const candidates = [];
830   if (fenced && fenced[1]) candidates.push(fenced[1].trim());
831   candidates.push(text);
832 
833   const firstBrace = text.indexOf('{');
834   const lastBrace = text.lastIndexOf('}');
835   if (firstBrace !== -1 && lastBrace > firstBrace) {
836     candidates.push(text.slice(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1));
837   }
838 
839   for (const c of candidates) {
840     try {
841       const parsed = JSON.parse(c);
842       if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
843     } catch {
844       // try the next candidate — never fabricate
845     }
846   }
847   return null;
848 }
849 
850 /**
851  * True when every stage's oranges are just the generic defaults (or empty).
852  *
853  * WHY THIS IS A FAILURE, not a warning. The Oranges annotations are the single thing John
854  * named as non-negotiable ("the steward thinks 2-3 steps ahead and surfaces what he hasn't
855  * asked yet"). A proposal that echoes DEFAULT_ORANGES_PROMPTS back is a model that did not
856  * do the work, and shipping it would LOOK like the feature while being the old placeholder.
857  *
858  * @param {Array<{oranges?: Array}>} stages
859  * @returns {boolean}
860  */
861 export function orangesAreGeneric(stages) {
862   const list = Array.isArray(stages) ? stages : [];
863   if (!list.length) return true;
864   const defaults = new Set(DEFAULT_ORANGES_PROMPTS.map((s) => String(s).trim().toLowerCase()));
865   return list.every((s) => {
866     const o = Array.isArray(s?.oranges) ? s.oranges : [];
867     const real = o
868       .map((x) => String(x ?? '').trim())
869       .filter(Boolean)
870       .filter((x) => !defaults.has(x.toLowerCase()));
871     return real.length === 0;
872   });
873 }
874 
875 /**
876  * Validate + normalize a seat reply into the steward's typed shape.
877  *
878  * @param {string|object} raw
879  * @returns {{ ok: true, reply: object } | ReturnType<typeof converseFailure>}
880  */
881 export function parseStewardReply(raw) {
882   const obj = typeof raw === 'object' && raw !== null ? raw : extractReplyJson(raw);
883   if (!obj) return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.REPLY_UNPARSEABLE, { raw_preview: previewOf(raw) });
884 
885   const say = String(obj.say ?? '').trim();
886   if (!say) return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.REPLY_EMPTY, { raw_preview: previewOf(raw) });
887 
888   const asks = Array.isArray(obj.asks)
889     ? obj.asks.map((a) => String(a ?? '').trim()).filter(Boolean)
890     : [];
891 
892   const p = obj.proposal;
893   if (p == null || p === false) {
894     // Still talking. This is the conversation working, NOT a failure.
895     //
896     // `wants_plan` is how the CONVERSATIONAL tier hands off: it cannot write a
897     // scaffolding itself (see STEWARD_TALK_INSTRUCTION), so when the conversation has
898     // earned one it says so and the FRONTIER tier frames it as a separate turn.
899     return {
900       ok: true,
901       reply: {
902         say,
903         asks,
904         proposal: null,
905         gathering: true,
906         // E1 (steward-e1 W2): the seat's typed answers to John's direct
907         // question ids ride through VERBATIM shape-checked — the
908         // turn-completion hook validates coverage, never invents one.
909         answer_references: Array.isArray(obj.answer_references)
910           ? obj.answer_references : [],
911         wants_plan: obj.wants_plan === true,
912         plan_brief: String(obj.plan_brief ?? '').trim() || null,
913         // Detail he gave about the step in hand, captured AS HE TALKS rather than
914         // demanded up front. Recorded as typed elaboration events by converse().
915         answers: (obj.answers && typeof obj.answers === 'object' && !Array.isArray(obj.answers))
916           ? obj.answers : null,
917         // Steward feedback — written durably by converse(); never a claimed act.
918         journal: (Array.isArray(obj.journal) ? obj.journal : [])
919           .map((j) => String(j ?? '').trim()).filter(Boolean),
920         // "Start Gandalf" routes to the commission card — the model must never
921         // say work started (it cannot start anything); it signals instead.
922         wants_commission: obj.wants_commission === true,
923         commission_skill: String(obj.commission_skill ?? '').trim() || null,
924         commission_directive: String(obj.commission_directive ?? '').trim() || null,
925         // High Seat portfolio turns: a spoken "start a project" lands as a
926         // typed, confirmable act — name + folder exactly as John gave them.
927         project_create: (obj.project_create && typeof obj.project_create === 'object'
928           && String(obj.project_create.folder ?? '').trim())
929           ? {
930             name: String(obj.project_create.name ?? '').trim() || null,
931             folder: String(obj.project_create.folder ?? '').trim(),
932             // R11 (2026-09-28): the dashboard folder he named, when he named one — the confirm card preselects it
933             group: String(obj.project_create.group ?? '').trim() || null,
934           }
935           : null,
936       },
937     };
938   }
939   if (typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p)) {
940     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.PROPOSAL_INVALID, { error: 'proposal_not_object' });
941   }
942 
943   const kickoffShaped = p.kind === 'kickoff'
944     || p.work_product != null
945     || p.plan_entries != null
946     || p.success_signals != null;
947   if (kickoffShaped) {
948     // Parse step only: shape and ids, nothing invented. Provenance (which seat
949     // answered) is the host's assertion and is applied when converse() proposes
950     // the bundle; a reply cannot stamp its own provenance.
951     const normalized = normalizeKickoffInput(p);
952     if (!normalized.ok) {
953       return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.PROPOSAL_INVALID, {
954         error: normalized.error ?? 'kickoff_proposal_invalid',
955         kickoff_validation: normalized,
956       });
957     }
958     return {
959       ok: true,
960       reply: {
961         say,
962         asks,
963         gathering: false,
964         answer_references: Array.isArray(obj.answer_references)
965           ? obj.answer_references : [],
966         proposal: {
967           kind: 'kickoff',
968           ...normalized.content,
969         },
970       },
971     };
972   }
973 
974   const kind = p.kind === 'next_stage' ? 'next_stage' : 'scaffolding';
975   const goal = String(p.goal ?? '').trim();
976 
977   const stages = (Array.isArray(p.stages) ? p.stages : [])
978     .map((s) => {
979       if (typeof s === 'string') return { name: s.trim(), oranges: [] };
980       if (!s || typeof s !== 'object') return null;
981       const name = String(s.name ?? '').trim();
982       if (!name) return null;
983       // Only the four commissionable kinds ride through — anything else the
984       // model invents is dropped rather than written to the ledger.
985       const stepType = String(s.step_type ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
986       return {
987         name,
988         done_when: nonEmptyOr(s.done_when, '') || undefined,
989         oranges: (Array.isArray(s.oranges) ? s.oranges : [])
990           .map((o) => String(o ?? '').trim())
991           .filter(Boolean),
992         step_type: ['RESEARCH', 'PLAN', 'BUILD', 'REVIEW'].includes(stepType)
993           ? stepType
994           : undefined,
995       };
996     })
997     .filter(Boolean);
998 
999   if (!stages.length) {
1000     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.PROPOSAL_INVALID, { error: 'proposal_no_stages' });
1001   }
1002   if (!goal) {
1003     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.PROPOSAL_INVALID, { error: 'proposal_no_goal' });
1004   }
1005   if (orangesAreGeneric(stages)) {
1006     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.ORANGES_GENERIC, { error: 'oranges_generic' });
1007   }
1008 
1009   const foresight = (Array.isArray(p.foresight) ? p.foresight : [])
1010     .map((f) => String(f ?? '').trim())
1011     .filter(Boolean);
1012 
1013   return {
1014     ok: true,
1015     reply: {
1016       say,
1017       asks,
1018       gathering: false,
1019       // E1 (steward-e1 W2): a proposal turn discharges John's question ids
1020       // the same way a talking turn does — through typed answer-references.
1021       answer_references: Array.isArray(obj.answer_references)
1022         ? obj.answer_references : [],
1023       proposal: { kind, goal, stages, foresight },
1024     },
1025   };
1026 }
1027 
1028 function previewOf(raw) {
1029   return String(raw ?? '').trim().slice(0, 200);
1030 }
1031 
1032 // ── Seat-output hygiene ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1033 
1034 /**
1035  * Keep ONLY the seat metadata we actually need, and prove it carries no vendor product
1036  * model IDs.
1037  *
1038  * WHY. The transport probe (2026-08-04) showed a real reply carries
1039  * `modelUsage: {"claude-fable-5": …}`. `seating.findProductModelIds` forbids product IDs
1040  * on seat stamps, so passing raw seat metadata into a durable event would trip a canary
1041  * later, far from its cause. Constructing a whitelist is safer than scrubbing a blob.
1042  *
1043  * @param {object} meta
1044  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, usage: object, product_model_ids: string[] }}
1045  */
1046 export function sanitizeSeatMeta(meta = {}) {
1047   const usage = {
1048     tokens: Number(meta?.tokens) || 0,
1049     cost_usd: Number(meta?.cost_usd) || 0,
1050     duration_ms: Number(meta?.duration_ms) || 0,
1051     seat_family: typeof meta?.seat_family === 'string' ? meta.seat_family : null,
1052     driver: typeof meta?.driver === 'string' ? meta.driver : null,
1053     // Audit scalars (2026-08-31 Fable review): what was REQUESTED of the seat and
1054     // whether the served family was attested — without them no post-turn audit can
1055     // tell an Ultra planning call from a default one, or an attested serve from a
1056     // hopeful one. Scalars only; the raw trio receipt stays out of durable events
1057     // (it may carry product model ids).
1058     reasoning_effort: typeof meta?.reasoning_effort === 'string' ? meta.reasoning_effort : null,
1059     orchestration_mode: typeof meta?.orchestration_mode === 'string' ? meta.orchestration_mode : null,
1060     served_family: typeof meta?.served_family === 'string' ? meta.served_family : null,
1061     served_family_attested: meta?.served_family_attested === true,
1062   };
1063   const hits = findProductModelIds(usage);
1064   return { ok: hits.length === 0, usage, product_model_ids: hits };
1065 }
1066 
1067 // ── E1 turn-completion hook (steward-e1 W2 — the W8 row, engine leg) ───────
1068 //
1069 // The criterion: a steward turn structurally CANNOT close while a RATIFIED
1070 // direct question id lacks a typed answer-reference. The BOUND (the
1071 // deterministic question parse, the F7 ratification reader) is OWNED by the
1072 // Anchor sibling's chamber_e1_bound.py — it is never re-implemented here.
1073 // The caller (anchor_gui → seal-chamber-bridge --e1) computes the question
1074 // ids + the ratification state THERE and injects them as `opts.e1`; this
1075 // hook only validates typed answer-reference COVERAGE and refuses the close.
1076 //
1077 // FAIL CLOSED, by name: an absent / unratified / altered bound payload
1078 // yields an `unenforceable` verdict carrying its named finding — never a
1079 // silent clean pass — while the turn itself is NOT blocked (a steward turn
1080 // is never blocked against a bound John has not signed; the F7 artifact's
1081 // own law). Only a signed, enforceable bound may block.
1082 
1083 export const E1_FINDING = Object.freeze({
1084   BLOCKED: 'E1-TURN-CLOSE-BLOCKED',
1085   UNRATIFIED: 'E1-BOUND-UNRATIFIED',
1086   ARTIFACT_MISSING: 'E1-F7-ARTIFACT-MISSING',
1087 });
1088 
1089 export const E1_DECISION = Object.freeze({
1090   CLOSE: 'close',
1091   BLOCK: 'block',
1092   UNENFORCEABLE: 'unenforceable',
1093 });
1094 
1095 // The deterministic id shape chamber_e1_bound.question_id mints (qNN-<12 hex>).
1096 const E1_QUESTION_ID_RE = /^q\d{2,}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
1097 
1098 /**
1099  * The VALID typed answer-references a parsed reply carries. A seat-provided
1100  * partial `{question_id, answer_text}` is completed with the machinery-owned
1101  * fields (`schema_version` / `answered_in`); an entry that still fails the
1102  * typed shape (bad id, empty answer) is DROPPED — an invalid reference must
1103  * never look answered.
1104  * @param {object} reply parsed steward reply (inner object)
1105  * @returns {Array<{schema_version:number,question_id:string,answered_in:string,answer_text:string}>}
1106  */
1107 export function normalizeAnswerReferences(reply) {
1108   const raw = Array.isArray(reply?.answer_references) ? reply.answer_references : [];
1109   const out = [];
1110   for (const entry of raw) {
1111     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') continue;
1112     const qid = String(entry.question_id ?? '').trim();
1113     const text = String(entry.answer_text ?? '').trim();
1114     if (!E1_QUESTION_ID_RE.test(qid) || !text) continue;
1115     out.push({
1116       schema_version: 1,
1117       question_id: qid,
1118       answered_in: String(entry.answered_in ?? 'steward-reply').trim() || 'steward-reply',
1119       answer_text: text,
1120     });
1121   }
1122   return out;
1123 }
1124 
1125 /**
1126  * THE TURN-COMPLETION HOOK (engine leg). Pure — no fs, no model, no clock.
1127  * @param {object} reply parsed steward reply (inner object)
1128  * @param {object|null} e1 the bound payload the bridge boundary injected
1129  * @returns {{decision:string, enforced:boolean, finding:string|null, reason:string|null,
1130  *            unanswered:Array, answered:Array}}
1131  */
1132 export function enforceTurnCompletion(reply, e1) {
1133   if (!e1 || typeof e1 !== 'object') {
1134     return {
1135       decision: E1_DECISION.UNENFORCEABLE, enforced: false,
1136       finding: E1_FINDING.ARTIFACT_MISSING,
1137       reason: 'no ratified bound rode this turn (the --e1 payload is absent) '
1138         + '— fail closed by name, never silently open',
1139       unanswered: [], answered: [],
1140     };
1141   }
1142   if (e1.enforceable !== true) {
1143     return {
1144       decision: E1_DECISION.UNENFORCEABLE, enforced: false,
1145       finding: String(e1.finding ?? E1_FINDING.UNRATIFIED),
1146       reason: String(e1.reason ?? 'the E1 bound is not ratified — '
1147         + 'enforcement fails closed until John\'s signature is on disk'),
1148       unanswered: [], answered: [],
1149     };
1150   }
1151   const questions = Array.isArray(e1.questions) ? e1.questions : [];
1152   const answered = normalizeAnswerReferences(reply);
1153   const answeredIds = new Set(answered.map((r) => r.question_id));
1154   const unanswered = questions
1155     .filter((q) => q && q.question_id && !answeredIds.has(q.question_id))
1156     .map((q) => ({
1157       question_id: q.question_id, text: q.text ?? null,
1158       kind: q.kind ?? null, rule: q.rule ?? null,
1159     }));
1160   if (unanswered.length) {
1161     return {
1162       decision: E1_DECISION.BLOCK, enforced: true,
1163       finding: E1_FINDING.BLOCKED,
1164       reason: 'a ratified direct question id lacks a typed answer-reference '
1165         + '— the engine refuses to close this turn (E1, per the F7-signed bound)',
1166       unanswered, answered,
1167     };
1168   }
1169   return {
1170     decision: E1_DECISION.CLOSE, enforced: true,
1171     finding: null, reason: null, unanswered: [], answered,
1172   };
1173 }
1174 
1175 // ── The turn ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1176 
1177 /**
1178  * One conversational turn.
1179  *
1180  * Order matters and is deliberate:
1181  *   route (deterministic, free) → context → envelope PRE-check (refuse BEFORE spending)
1182  *   → seat call (injected) → parse → debit ONCE → propose through the existing spine.
1183  *
1184  * A proposal is emitted through `proposeScaffolding`, so it lands as the SAME typed
1185  * `scaffold_proposal` event the confirm path already knows how to hash-bind and batch
1186  * confirm. Nothing here writes steps; confirming remains a separate, explicit human act.
1187  *
1188  * @param {string} projectPath
1189  * @param {{
1190  *   utterance: string,
1191  *   turns?: Array<{role: string, text: string}>,
1192  *   seatCall?: (prompt: string, ctx: object) => Promise<{ok: boolean, text?: string, meta?: object, reason?: string}>,
1193  *   seats?: object,
1194  *   prefs?: object,
1195  *   env?: object,
1196  *   session?: object,
1197  *   client_event_id?: string,
1198  *   auth?: object,
1199  *   at?: string,
1200  * }} opts
1201  */
1202 export async function converse(projectPath, opts = {}) {
1203   // 0. MISSING and EMPTY are separate rows (Gate 5 / Wave 3): no utterance at all is not
1204   //    the same fact as an utterance with nothing in it, and neither is a seat failure.
1205   if (opts.utterance == null) {
1206     return kickoffTalkFailure(KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.MISSING, {
1207       error: 'utterance_missing',
1208       model_called: false,
1209     });
1210   }
1211   const utterance = String(opts.utterance);
1212 
1213   // 1. Control verbs never reach a model, and never spend.
1214   const routed = routeUtterance(utterance, { session: opts.session });
1215   if (routed.lane === 'refuse') {
1216     if (routed.reason === 'destructive_free_form') {
1217       return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.DESTRUCTIVE, { error: routed.reason, routed: routed.lane });
1218     }
1219     return kickoffTalkFailure(KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.EMPTY, {
1220       error: routed.reason,
1221       routed: routed.lane,
1222       model_called: false,
1223     });
1224   }
1225   if (routed.lane === 'act') {
1226     return {
1227       ok: true,
1228       lane: 'act',
1229       compiled: routed.compiled,
1230       say: `Understood that as: ${routed.compiled.label ?? routed.compiled.act}.`,
1231       model_called: false,
1232       spent: false,
1233       ledger_write: false,
1234       dialogue_persisted: false,
1235     };
1236   }
1237 
1238   // 2. Rebuild durable context. A Face is a post-confirm projection, not a
1239   // brainstorming precondition; an empty project is valid kickoff context.
1240   const context = loadStewardContext(projectPath);
1241   if (!context.ok) {
1242     if (context.store_check) {
1243       // The store's own named row (unreadable / corrupt / bound) rides through unchanged.
1244       return {
1245         ...context.store_check,
1246         say: context.store_check.user_text,
1247         lane: 'converse',
1248         conversational: true,
1249         model_called: false,
1250         ledger_write: false,
1251         dialogue_persisted: false,
1252       };
1253     }
1254     return converseFailure(context.code ?? CONVERSE_CODE.KICKOFF_CORRUPT, {
1255       context_check: context,
1256     });
1257   }
1258 
1259   // 3. Seat must be safe BEFORE we send anything anywhere.
1260   const seats = opts.seats ?? resolveSeats({ prefs: opts.prefs, env: opts.env });
1261   if (!seats.ok || !isProductionSeatSafe(seats)) {
1262     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.SEAT_UNSAFE, {
1263       error: seats.error ?? 'seat_unsafe',
1264       seat_message: seats.message ?? null,
1265     });
1266   }
1267 
1268   // 4. BACKGROUND ALLOWANCE (John, 2026-08-05). Talking used to require confirming a
1269   //    budget before the steward would say anything: "I really don't want to do that.
1270   //    Might have like a background amount of effort and if it hits there then it can
1271   //    say hey we've hit this threshold do you want to carry on."
1272   //
1273   //    So an allowance opens ON ITS OWN the first time he talks. The law it replaces is
1274   //    "nothing spent without prior confirmation"; the law it keeps is the one that
1275   //    matters — the steward STOPS at the cap and asks, and cannot go past it without
1276   //    him saying so. Reaching the cap is a checkpoint (see BUDGET_REACHED below).
1277   let envState = readEnvelopeState(projectPath, {});
1278   if ((!envState.ok || !envState.live) && envState.code !== ENVELOPE_CODE.EXHAUSTED) {
1279     const opened = opts.openAllowance
1280       ? opts.openAllowance(projectPath)
1281       : { ok: false, skipped: 'no_opener_injected' };
1282     if (opened.ok) envState = readEnvelopeState(projectPath, {});
1283   }
1284   // THE SILENT BOOTSTRAP (Gate 5 / Wave 3). A new effort has no Face, no envelope, no
1285   // budget - and none of them is a precondition for brainstorming. Nothing is prompted
1286   // and nothing is written here: the Face is created ON confirmation and the envelope is
1287   // materialized INSIDE the confirmation receipt (Wave 2); until then the turn's spend
1288   // rides the result. An envelope that EXISTS keeps its own law below (debit; stop at
1289   // the cap and ask).
1290   const bootstrap = settleKickoffBootstrap({ face: context.narrative, envelope_state: envState });
1291   if ((!envState.ok || !envState.live) && !bootstrap.spend_deferred) {
1292     // A REACHED CAP IS A CHECKPOINT, NOT A WALL (John, 2026-08-04). Say what has
1293     // actually been spent and offer to carry on, rather than a bare refusal — the
1294     // decision to go past it is his, and it stays a human confirmation.
1295     if (envState.code === ENVELOPE_CODE.EXHAUSTED) {
1296       // readEnvelopeState nests the numbers under `balance` — reading them off the
1297       // top level silently yields undefined, and the checkpoint would have told John
1298       // "$0.00 of $0.00 spent", which is worse than no number at all.
1299       const bal = envState.balance ?? envState;
1300       const spent = Number(bal.spent_usd) || 0;
1301       const cap = bal.max_spend_usd;
1302       const onSpend = bal.bound !== 'compiles';
1303       return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.BUDGET_REACHED, {
1304         code: CONVERSE_CODE.BUDGET_REACHED,
1305         status_code: CONVERSE_CODE.BUDGET_REACHED,
1306         bound: bal.bound ?? 'spend',
1307         spent_usd: spent,
1308         max_spend_usd: cap ?? null,
1309         envelope: envState,
1310         can_raise: onSpend,
1311         say: onSpend
1312           ? `We've reached the session budget — ${formatSpend(spent)} of `
1313             + `${formatSpend(cap ?? 0)} spent. I've stopped rather than keep `
1314             + 'spending. Tell me to carry on and I will, or raise the cap and we keep going.'
1315           : 'We\'ve reached this session\'s turn limit. Confirm a fresh budget and we carry on.',
1316       });
1317     }
1318     const code =
1319       envState.code === ENVELOPE_CODE.EXPIRED ? ENVELOPE_CODE.EXPIRED
1320       : CONVERSE_CODE.NO_ENVELOPE;
1321     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.NO_ENVELOPE, {
1322       code,
1323       status_code: code,
1324       envelope: envState,
1325     });
1326   }
1327 
1328   // 5. The seat call itself — injected, because engine/ may not spawn.
1329   //    The E1 bound payload (opts.e1, computed by the Anchor owner and
1330   //    injected at the bridge boundary) rides into the prompt's conditional
1331   //    ANSWER LAW block and into the turn-completion hook below.
1332   const prompt = buildStewardPrompt(context, utterance, { turns: opts.turns, e1: opts.e1 });
1333   if (typeof opts.seatCall !== 'function') {
1334     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.SEAT_UNREACHABLE, { error: 'no_seat_call_injected' });
1335   }
1336 
1337   // AFFORDABILITY, not just liveness. `live` only means "not yet over the cap" — an
1338   // envelope with a few cents left is live while the NEXT debit would be refused. Left
1339   // as-is the steward would spend a real model call and only then discover it could not
1340   // record the spend: money out, ledger silent. Stop at the checkpoint BEFORE the call.
1341   const balance = envState.balance ?? {};
1342   const remaining = balance.remaining_usd;
1343   if (remaining != null && Number.isFinite(Number(remaining))) {
1344     const estimate = Number(priceCompile(prompt, { seat: 'compile' }).cost_usd) || 0;
1345     if (estimate > Number(remaining)) {
1346       const spent = Number(balance.spent_usd) || 0;
1347       const cap = Number(balance.max_spend_usd) || 0;
1348       return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.BUDGET_REACHED, {
1349         code: CONVERSE_CODE.BUDGET_REACHED,
1350         status_code: CONVERSE_CODE.BUDGET_REACHED,
1351         bound: 'spend',
1352         spent_usd: spent,
1353         max_spend_usd: cap,
1354         estimated_next_usd: estimate,
1355         can_raise: true,
1356         say:
1357           `This next turn would take us past the session budget — ${formatSpend(spent)} of `
1358           + `${formatSpend(cap)} spent already. I've stopped rather than run it. `
1359           + 'Raise the cap and I will carry straight on.',
1360       });
1361     }
1362   }
1363 
1364   const callSeat = async (text, role) => {
1365     try {
1366       return await opts.seatCall(text, {
1367         seat_family: seats.coding_family,
1368         driver: seats.coding_driver,
1369         role,
1370         // Only the planning turn is granted read-only project access.
1371         project_path: context.project_path,
1372       });
1373     } catch (e) {
1374       return { ok: false, reason: 'seat_call_threw', detail: String(e?.message ?? e) };
1375     }
1376   };
1377 
1378   // TALK FIRST, ALWAYS. The conversational tier holds the exchange and cannot write a
1379   // scaffolding — so the steward can never open by dumping a finished plan on him.
1380   let seatResult = await callSeat(prompt, SEAT_ROLE.CONVERSATIONAL);
1381   if (!seatResult || seatResult.ok !== true || !String(seatResult.text ?? '').trim()) {
1382     return converseFailure(CONVERSE_CODE.SEAT_UNREACHABLE, {
1383       error: 'seat_call_failed',
1384       reason: seatResult?.reason ?? 'no_reply',
1385       detail: seatResult?.detail,
1386     });
1387   }
1388 
1389   // 6. Parse strictly. An unreadable reply is reported, never salvaged.
1390   let parsed = parseStewardReply(seatResult.text);
1391   if (!parsed.ok) return { ...parsed, seat_reached: true };
1392 
1393   // PLAN SECOND, RARELY. Only when the conversation earned it does the FRONTIER tier
1394   // run — the slow, deep, expensive turn — and only that turn may frame a scaffolding.
1395   // A compact provisional proposal can be explicitly requested. The number of
1396   // exchanges never overrides adaptive discovery or the retained answers.
1397   const turnNumber = kickoffTurnNumber(opts.turns);
1398   const thinTurn = kickoffNeedsThinProposal({
1399     explicit_thin_proposal: opts.thin_proposal === true,
1400     turn_number: turnNumber,
1401     open_proposal: context.open_proposal,
1402     confirmed_kickoff: context.confirmed_kickoff,
1403     step_count: context.projection.length,
1404   });
1405   const planForced = thinTurn && parsed.reply.wants_plan !== true && !parsed.reply.proposal;
1406   let planUsage = null;
1407   if (parsed.reply.wants_plan === true || planForced) {
1408     const planPrompt = buildStewardPrompt(context, utterance, {
1409       turns: opts.turns,
1410       planning: true,
1411       plan_brief: parsed.reply.plan_brief,
1412       e1: opts.e1,
1413       thin_turn: thinTurn ? turnNumber : null,
1414     });
1415     const planResult = await callSeat(planPrompt, SEAT_ROLE.FRONTIER);
1416     if (planResult?.ok === true && String(planResult.text ?? '').trim()) {
1417       const planParsed = parseStewardReply(planResult.text);
1418       if (planParsed.ok && planParsed.reply.proposal) {
1419         // Keep the talking turn's voice; take the frontier turn's plan.
1420         // E1: the talking turn's answer-references survive the merge — a
1421         // question the first turn answered must not become unanswered
1422         // because the frontier turn framed a plan.
1423         const talkRefs = Array.isArray(parsed.reply.answer_references)
1424           ? parsed.reply.answer_references : [];
1425         const planRefs = Array.isArray(planParsed.reply.answer_references)
1426           ? planParsed.reply.answer_references : [];
1427         parsed = {
1428           ok: true,
1429           reply: {
1430             ...planParsed.reply,
1431             asks: parsed.reply.asks,
1432             gathering: false,
1433             answer_references: planRefs.length ? planRefs : talkRefs,
1434           },
1435         };
1436         planUsage = planResult.meta ?? null;
1437       }
1438     }
1439     // A failed planning turn is NOT a failed turn: he still gets the conversation, and
1440     // the steward says plainly that the framing did not come back rather than inventing
1441     // one. Falling through leaves `parsed` as the talking reply.
1442   }
1443 
1444   const meta = sanitizeSeatMeta({
1445     ...(seatResult.meta ?? {}),
1446     // A planning turn's tokens are the bulk of the spend — count both, or the debit
1447     // under-reports what was actually used.
1448     tokens: (Number(seatResult.meta?.tokens) || 0) + (Number(planUsage?.tokens) || 0),
1449     // Real dollars, both turns. The planning turn is the expensive one.
1450     cost_usd: (Number(seatResult.meta?.cost_usd) || 0) + (Number(planUsage?.cost_usd) || 0),
1451     seat_family: seats.coding_family,
1452     driver: seats.coding_driver,
1453   });
1454   // ACT on the check rather than merely computing it. An unread `ok` is a guard that
1455   // looks like protection and provides none — the exact shape this project has shipped
1456   // three times. If a vendor product model id reached the whitelist anyway, drop the
1457   // identity fields so nothing durable can carry one, and say so out loud.
1458   if (!meta.ok) {
1459     meta.usage.seat_family = null;
1460     meta.usage.driver = null;
1461     meta.usage.scrubbed_product_model_ids = meta.product_model_ids.length;
1462   }
1463   const reply = parsed.reply;
1464 
1465   // THE QUESTION CAP (Gate 5 / Wave 3): at most one natural question per turn, the North
1466   // Star's letter. The seat may write more; one is delivered and the rest are reported held.
1467   const capped = capKickoffQuestions(reply.asks);
1468   reply.asks = capped.asks;
1469   const questionsHeld = capped.held.length;
1470 
1471   // ONE debit seam for the closes below. With no envelope at all (a new effort) the spend
1472   // is DEFERRED - it rides the result and is materialized inside the confirmation receipt
1473   // - never silently dropped and never prompted for.
1474   const debitTurn = (suffix) => {
1475     if (bootstrap.spend_deferred) {
1476       return {
1477         ok: true,
1478         debited: false,
1479         deferred: true,
1480         deferred_to: bootstrap.envelope_materialized_in,
1481         tokens: meta.usage.tokens,
1482         cost_usd: meta.usage.cost_usd,
1483       };
1484     }
1485     return debitSessionEnvelope(projectPath, {
1486       kind: 'compile',
1487       text: prompt,
1488       tokens: meta.usage.tokens || undefined,
1489       cost_usd: meta.usage.cost_usd,
1490       auth: opts.auth,
1491       client_event_id: opts.client_event_id ? `${opts.client_event_id}-${suffix}` : undefined,
1492     });
1493   };
1494   const debitView = (debit) => (debit.deferred
1495     ? debit
1496     : debit.ok ? { debited: true, shown: debit.shown } : { debited: false, ...debit });
1497 
1498   // ── THE E1 TURN-COMPLETION HOOK (steward-e1 W2 — the W8 row) ─────────────
1499   // The turn attempts to close HERE. Under a RATIFIED bound, an open
1500   // question id with no typed answer-reference structurally blocks the
1501   // close with a named finding; an unratified/absent bound fails CLOSED by
1502   // name on the verdict (never a silent clean pass) without blocking. The
1503   // seat call already happened, so the spend is debited honestly either way
1504   // — a blocked turn never hides money that left.
1505   const turnClose = enforceTurnCompletion(reply, opts.e1 ?? null);
1506   if (turnClose.decision === E1_DECISION.BLOCK) {
1507     const debit = debitTurn('blocked');
1508     return {
1509       ok: true,
1510       lane: 'converse',
1511       turn_blocked: true,
1512       blocked: {
1513         finding: turnClose.finding,
1514         unanswered: turnClose.unanswered,
1515         // Nothing is lost: the reply is HELD, not delivered as a closed
1516         // turn — the drawn refusal state (V5 AG-BLOCKED-TURN) is what John
1517         // sees, so the cure never looks like "are you working".
1518         held_say: reply.say,
1519         message: 'The engine refused to close this turn: a direct question '
1520           + 'from John still lacks a typed answer-reference.',
1521       },
1522       turn_close: turnClose,
1523       say: 'The engine refused to close this turn: a direct question from '
1524         + 'John still lacks a typed answer-reference.',
1525       model_called: true,
1526       seat: { family: seats.coding_family, driver: seats.coding_driver },
1527       usage: meta.usage,
1528       debit: debitView(debit),
1529       steps_written: false,
1530       ledger_write: false,
1531       dialogue_persisted: false,
1532     };
1533   }
1534 
1535   // THE AMBIGUOUS ROW (Gate 5 / Wave 3): the thin turn came and went and the seat still
1536   // has no bundle. Named, with NO question attached (never a third question); the spend
1537   // is accounted honestly; nothing is written and the exchange is not recorded as a close.
1538   if (thinTurn && !reply.proposal) {
1539     const debit = debitTurn('ambiguous');
1540     return kickoffTalkFailure(KICKOFF_TALK_CODE.AMBIGUOUS, {
1541       error: 'no_bundle_by_thin_turn',
1542       turn: turnNumber,
1543       turn_number: turnNumber,
1544       plan_forced: planForced,
1545       held_say: reply.say,
1546       questions_held: questionsHeld + reply.asks.length,
1547       gathering: true,
1548       model_called: true,
1549       seat: { family: seats.coding_family, driver: seats.coding_driver },
1550       usage: meta.usage,
1551       debit: debitView(debit),
1552       turn_close: turnClose,
1553       steps_written: false,
1554       bootstrap,
1555     });
1556   }
1557 
1558   // Record the exchange. Durable, append-only, and NEVER authoritative: this is how
1559   // John reads back why the plan changed, not where the plan currently stands.
1560   const recordTurns = (proposalHash, itemCount = 0, proposalKind = 'scaffold') => {
1561     const appended = appendConversationTurns(
1562       projectPath,
1563       [{ role: 'john', text: utterance }, { role: 'steward', text: reply.say }],
1564       {
1565         proposal_hash: proposalHash ?? null,
1566         kind: proposalHash ? `${proposalKind}_proposed` : 'conversation',
1567         at: opts.at,
1568       },
1569     );
1570     // Portfolio memory: WHAT THE STEWARD DID, never what the project is. Best-effort —
1571     // the steward's own bookkeeping must not break a turn John cares about.
1572     noteStewardEffort({
1573       kind: proposalHash ? `${proposalKind}_proposed` : 'conversation',
1574       project_path: projectPath,
1575       project_id: opts.project_id ?? context.strip?.project_id ?? null,
1576       at: opts.at,
1577       summary: proposalHash
1578         ? proposalKind === 'kickoff'
1579           ? `Proposed kickoff synthesis v${reply.proposal?.version ?? 'next'} with ${itemCount} plan entries`
1580           : `Proposed a ${itemCount}-stage scaffolding`
1581         : 'Talked through the project; no proposal yet',
1582     });
1583     if (reply.asks?.length) {
1584       noteStewardEffort({
1585         kind: 'question_raised',
1586         project_path: projectPath,
1587         project_id: opts.project_id ?? context.strip?.project_id ?? null,
1588         at: opts.at,
1589         summary: reply.asks[0],
1590       });
1591     }
1592     return appended;
1593   };
1594 
1595   // STEWARD FEEDBACK LANDS FOR REAL. The seat used to SAY "journaled" with no
1596   // hands (fabricated act, caught live 2026-08-06); now the reply's typed
1597   // journal entries are written durably here, and only this makes it true.
1598   let journaled = null;
1599   if (Array.isArray(reply.journal) && reply.journal.length) {
1600     const fed = appendStewardFeedback(projectPath, reply.journal, { at: opts.at });
1601     journaled = fed.ok
1602       ? { entries: fed.appended }
1603       : { entries: 0, error: fed.error };
1604   }
1605 
1606   // DETAIL ACCRUES BY TALKING. When he answered something the step in hand was missing,
1607   // it lands as a typed elaboration_answer on the spine — so the plan fills in as the
1608   // conversation goes, and he never has to sit down and scaffold it all up front.
1609   let elaborated = null;
1610   if (reply.answers && context.active_step && Object.keys(reply.answers).length) {
1611     const rec = recordElaborationAnswers(projectPath, {
1612       step_id: context.active_step.step_id ?? context.active_step.id,
1613       answers: reply.answers,
1614       who: opts.who ?? 'john',
1615       at: opts.at,
1616     });
1617     elaborated = rec.ok
1618       ? { recorded: Object.keys(reply.answers), step_id: rec.step_id ?? null }
1619       : { recorded: [], error: rec.error ?? rec.code };
1620   }
1621 
1622   // 7. No proposal yet — still gathering. Debit the call that was actually made.
1623   if (!reply.proposal) {
1624     const logged = recordTurns(null);
1625     const debit = debitTurn('turn');
1626     return {
1627       ok: true,
1628       lane: 'converse',
1629       say: reply.say,
1630       asks: reply.asks,
1631       gathering: true,
1632       proposal: null,
1633       turn_number: turnNumber,
1634       questions_held: questionsHeld,
1635       plan_forced: planForced,
1636       bootstrap,
1637       // E1 (steward-e1 W2): every converse close carries its turn-close
1638       // verdict — an unenforceable bound rides BY NAME, never silently open.
1639       turn_close: turnClose,
1640       model_called: true,
1641       seat: { family: seats.coding_family, driver: seats.coding_driver },
1642       usage: meta.usage,
1643       debit: debitView(debit),
1644       // Said explicitly rather than left undefined: a talking turn writes no steps, and
1645       // a caller checking `steps_written === false` deserves a true answer, not absence.
1646       steps_written: false,
1647       elaborated,
1648       journaled,
1649       // The chamber shows the commission card on this signal — the model
1650       // routes "start Gandalf" here instead of pretending work began.
1651       wants_commission: reply.wants_commission === true,
1652       commission_skill: reply.commission_skill ?? null,
1653       commission_directive: reply.commission_directive ?? null,
1654       // Spoken project management from the High Seat: the host renders the
1655       // confirm card; nothing is created until John clicks it.
1656       project_create: reply.project_create ?? null,
1657       ledger_write: false,
1658       // The transcript IS now kept (durable, non-authoritative). Say so honestly
1659       // rather than leaving a stale `false` that misdescribes what happened.
1660       dialogue_persisted: logged.ok === true,
1661       conversation_log: logged.ok
1662         ? { appended: logged.appended, total: logged.total }
1663         : { appended: 0, error: logged.error ?? logged.code },
1664     };
1665   }
1666 
1667   // 8. A proposal. New kickoff synthesis uses its own strict lineage; legacy
1668   // scaffolding remains available for recorded replies and established callers.
1669   const kickoffProposal = reply.proposal.kind === 'kickoff';
1670   let proposed;
1671   let legacyRoadmap = null;
1672   if (kickoffProposal) {
1673     const debit = debitTurn('kickoff-debit');
1674     if (!debit.ok) {
1675       return {
1676         ...debit,
1677         lane: 'converse',
1678         say: reply.say,
1679         asks: reply.asks,
1680         model_called: true,
1681         conversational: true,
1682       };
1683     }
1684     // THE STORE is the lineage of record (Gate 5 / Wave 2's one store): the WHOLE bundle,
1685     // v1 on an empty lineage, superseding at the same version before a confirmation,
1686     // v(n+1) after one. The host asserts which seat authored it; nothing else is written.
1687     const host = {
1688       seat_family: meta.usage.seat_family,
1689       driver: meta.usage.driver,
1690       source_turn_id: opts.client_event_id ?? null,
1691       client_event_id: opts.client_event_id
1692         ? `${opts.client_event_id}-kickoff-propose` : undefined,
1693       at: opts.at,
1694     };
1695     proposed = openKickoffBundle(projectPath, {
1696       bundle: reply.proposal,
1697       ...host,
1698       timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs,
1699     });
1700     if (proposed.ok && usesLegacyRoadmapLane(context)) {
1701       // THE LEGACY LANE: a stood-up campaign (a Face on disk) keeps the pre-Gate-5
1702       // roadmap-ledger kickoff path beside the store - the WH4 lane's interaction,
1703       // unchanged. Same bundle, same seat lineage, same source turn: the same hash on an
1704       // agreeing lineage. A NEW effort never reaches this branch and writes only the store.
1705       const mirrored = proposeKickoff(projectPath, {
1706         proposal: reply.proposal,
1707         project_id: opts.project_id ?? context.strip?.project_id ?? null,
1708         ...host,
1709       });
1710       legacyRoadmap = mirrored.ok
1711         ? {
1712           written: mirrored.event != null,
1713           proposal_hash: mirrored.proposal_hash,
1714           diverged: mirrored.proposal_hash !== proposed.proposal_hash,
1715         }
1716         : { written: false, code: mirrored.code, error: mirrored.error };
1717     }
1718     if (proposed.ok) {
1719       proposed.debit = debit.deferred
1720         ? debit
1721         : {
1722           ok: true,
1723           debited: true,
1724           shown: debit.shown,
1725           cost_usd: debit.shown?.cost_usd ?? debit.pricing?.cost_usd,
1726           envelope_id: debit.envelope_id ?? debit.envelope?.envelope_id,
1727           pricing: debit.pricing,
1728         };
1729     }
1730   } else {
1731     proposed = proposeScaffolding(projectPath, {
1732       goal: reply.proposal.goal,
1733       stages: reply.proposal.stages.map((s) => ({
1734         name: s.name,
1735         done_when: s.done_when,
1736         oranges: s.oranges,
1737         ...(s.step_type ? { step_type: s.step_type } : {}),
1738       })),
1739       tokens: meta.usage.tokens || undefined,
1740       cost_usd: meta.usage.cost_usd,
1741       auth: opts.auth,
1742       client_event_id: opts.client_event_id ? `${opts.client_event_id}-propose` : undefined,
1743       at: opts.at,
1744     });
1745   }
1746 
1747   if (!proposed.ok) {
1748     return {
1749       ...proposed,
1750       lane: 'converse',
1751       say: reply.say,
1752       asks: reply.asks,
1753       model_called: true,
1754       conversational: true,
1755     };
1756   }
1757 
1758   // Tagged with the proposal hash, so the reasoning can be read alongside the exact
1759   // proposal version it produced — the "how did we get here" John asked for.
1760   const itemCount = kickoffProposal
1761     ? proposed.proposal.plan_entries.length
1762     : proposed.proposal.steps.length;
1763   const logged = recordTurns(
1764     proposed.proposal_hash,
1765     itemCount,
1766     kickoffProposal ? 'kickoff' : 'scaffold',
1767   );
1768 
1769   return {
1770     ok: true,
1771     lane: 'converse',
1772     say: reply.say,
1773     asks: reply.asks,
1774     gathering: false,
1775     // E1 (steward-e1 W2): the proposal close carries its verdict too.
1776     turn_close: turnClose,
1777     conversation_log: logged.ok
1778       ? { appended: logged.appended, total: logged.total }
1779       : { appended: 0, error: logged.error ?? logged.code },
1780     proposal: proposed.proposal,
1781     proposal_hash: proposed.proposal_hash,
1782     proposal_id: proposed.proposal_id,
1783     proposal_kind: reply.proposal.kind,
1784     ...(kickoffProposal
1785       ? {
1786         plan_entry_count: proposed.proposal.plan_entries.length,
1787         // What the chamber shows and sends back: the prose John reads and BOTH hashes the
1788         // confirmation binds. State is the store's; the roadmap mirror is named beside it.
1789         rendered_prose: proposed.rendered_prose,
1790         rendered_prose_hash: proposed.rendered_prose_hash,
1791         version: proposed.version,
1792         prior_confirmed_hash: proposed.prior_confirmed_hash ?? null,
1793         supersedes: proposed.supersedes ?? null,
1794         kickoff_state: proposed.state,
1795         kickoff_phase: proposed.phase,
1796         legacy_roadmap: legacyRoadmap,
1797         turn_number: turnNumber,
1798         questions_held: questionsHeld,
1799         plan_forced: planForced,
1800         bootstrap,
1801       }
1802       : {
1803         foresight: reply.proposal.foresight,
1804         step_count: proposed.proposal.steps.length,
1805       }),
1806     model_called: true,
1807     seat: { family: seats.coding_family, driver: seats.coding_driver },
1808     usage: meta.usage,
1809     debit: proposed.debit,
1810     steps_written: false,
1811     elaborated,
1812     journaled,
1813     ledger_write: proposed.event != null,
1814     authoritative: false,
1815     applied: false,
1816     dialogue_persisted: logged.ok === true,
1817     confirm_hint: kickoffProposal
1818       ? 'This is a preview, not project truth — confirm this exact version to apply it.'
1819       : 'Nothing is written yet — confirm and these become the campaign roadmap.',
1820   };
1821 }
1822 
1823 /**
1824  * Structural proof that a converse result carries no chat transcript into anything
1825  * durable. Used by the E5 test rather than trusting the prose above.
1826  *
1827  * @param {object} result
1828  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, leaked: string[] }}
1829  */
1830 export function assertNoChatLeak(result) {
1831   const leaked = [];
1832   const walk = (v, trail) => {
1833     if (v == null) return;
1834     if (Array.isArray(v)) {
1835       v.forEach((item, i) => walk(item, `${trail}[${i}]`));
1836       return;
1837     }
1838     if (typeof v === 'object') {
1839       for (const [k, child] of Object.entries(v)) {
1840         if (/^(turns|transcript|chat|history|messages)$/i.test(k)) {
1841           leaked.push(trail ? `${trail}.${k}` : k);
1842         }
1843         walk(child, trail ? `${trail}.${k}` : k);
1844       }
1845     }
1846   };
1847   walk(result, '');
1848   return { ok: leaked.length === 0, leaked };
1849 }
1850 
1851 export { FACE_FILE_NAME, ACT_TABLE };
